relations.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain local emergency numbers list.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain extended local emergency numbers list.
UE ignores emergency numbers in non-3GPP REGISTRATION ACCEPT unless specific conditions are met.
Condition for UE not registered over 3GPP access requires EMM-NULL state.
Condition for UE not registered over 3GPP access requires EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Condition for UE not registered over 3GPP access requires EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state.
Condition for UE not registered over 3GPP access requires 5GMM-NULL state.
Condition for UE not registered over 3GPP access requires 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Condition for UE not registered over 3GPP access requires 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state.
